Arcane Turrets are environmental objects found in the Underdark.

Involvement

Arcane Turrets are Constructs, used by Lenore De Hurst to defend her Arcane Tower. They are immobile turrets which fire at any creature that gets near. They fire four times per turn, dealing 1d4 + 1⁠⁠Force damage with each shot to the closest target within a radius of 20 m (67 ft), and they always hit. These turrets have the  Sturdy condition and are vulnerable to antimagic and⁠Lightning damage. Strong non-resisted attacks such as  Eldritch Blast with  Agonising Blast or Two-Handed ⁠Bludgeoning weapons can also be used to damage them.

The turrets can be dealt with in several ways:

  • Arcane Turrets can be deactivated through restoring the power of the Arcane Tower with a  Sussur Bloom.
  • Arcane Turrets can be destroyed by reducing them to 0 HP.
  • Arcane Turrets can be temporarily disabled by a  Sussur Bloom, whether it is placed near them or held by a nearby character.
  • If the line-of-sight of an Arcane Turret is broken, such as by using a  Fog Cloud spell or taking cover, it is unable to fire.
  • Arcane Turrets do not shoot at invisible targets.
  • Arcane Turrets shoot at  Minor Illusions.

Arcane Turret enemy variants

  •  Arcane Cannon

Notes

  • Even after being disabled, the turrets can still be attacked, and XP is given upon a turret reaching zero hp.

Bugs

  • If a  Sussur Bloom is placed nearby a turret and the turret is then destroyed, it immediately revives and can start shooting again once the bloom is removed. This is not an issue if the Arcane Tower has been powered on before dealing with the turrets. The XP reward is only granted after destroying the turret for the first time.
